title: Drop the consumer-less agentCarrier root export from dsh-agent
task:
Problem: packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:23 re-exports `agentCarrier` (packages/core/agent/src/dispatch.ts:94) at the package root. Its only callers are inside the package: the default `carrier` argument of `agentEvents` at packages/core/agent/src/dispatch.ts:107. No file outside packages/core/agent/src (production, example, app, or test) references it and the package README never names it. The proposed prune note classifies such test-convenience and anticipatory root exports as SDK surface without an owner (packages/AGENTS.md: require a current owner and need).

Required: remove `agentCarrier` from the root export list at packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:23 and keep `agentEvents`, `assembleContextFor`, `emitAgentEvent` and the type exports on line 24 as they are; keep the function exported from dispatch.ts for its same-package caller. Run `pnpm run knip`: if it reports `agentCarrier` as an export used only in its own file, drop the `export` keyword in dispatch.ts instead. No behavior change.

Constraints: touch nothing else in the package; mechanical, local edit under the Agent Note exemption.
